Solar crosses economic tipping point; supercars fuel hybrid boom — energy transition accelerating
High-yield credit stress: Guggenheim/Acrisure debt drags HY markets; Goodyear burning cash in turnaround

market_outlook.short_term: Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole tone keeps rate-cut expectations muted through Q4 2026. Equities face headwinds from higher-for-longer rates but AI/tech momentum and NIO/SpaceX catalysts provide support. Geopolitical energy premiums (Russia diesel ban, Iran) add volatility. HY credit stress from Guggenheim/Acrisure warrants caution. Bitcoin consolidating near $81K.
market_outlook.long_term: US fiscal trajectory remains the dominant macro risk. AI capex supercycle (memory plants, open-weight M&A) supports tech earnings through 2027. Solar and hybrid energy transition create structural winners. Consumer bifurcation persists. Venezuela oil deal could reshape energy pricing by 2027. India banking volatility and Turkey regulatory tightening add EM risk. Labor market weakness early in Trump's term suggests structural headwinds.
